faqs.a: We prepare Ammonia Blue Print, setback and height compliance as per the current BNBC rules, a digital plot map.

faqs.q: Do you provide agreement-based turnkey construction?
faqs.a: Yes — fixed timeline, transparent BOQ, site supervision, quality checks, and handover within the estimated time.

faqs.q: What is included in design cost?
faqs.a: Floor plan, 3D, working drawing, structural, electrical and plumbing sheets. Area × rate: Basic, Standard, Premium, Premium Plus — per sft.
